title: [Activity] Measure the Performance of SVD Recommendations

cues.en: So it took a few minutes, but we got some valid results for our SVD recommender.
cues.zh: 花了幾分鐘，不過 SVD 推薦系統得到了有效的結果。

cues.en: Our RMSE score is about 0.9 and MAE is about 0.7.
cues.zh: RMSE 大約是 0.9，MAE 大約是 0.7。

cues.en: That means that, on average, our guess of a rating for a given movie for a given user was off by about 0.7 stars.
cues.zh: 這表示平均而言，我們對某位使用者、某部電影的評分預測，大約差了 0.7 顆星。

cues.en: RMSE is higher, meaning that we got penalized for being way off more often than we'd like.
cues.zh: RMSE 比較高，表示預測偏差很大的情況，比我們希望的更常出現，因此受到懲罰。

cues.en: Again, remember error metrics are bad.
cues.zh: 再次記得，誤差指標越大越不好。

cues.en: You want these values to be as low as possible if accuracy is your goal.
cues.zh: 如果目標是準確程度，就希望這些值越低越好。

cues.en: Our hit rate was just about 3%, which actually isn't that bad considering that only one movie was left out from each user's ratings to test with.
cues.zh: 命中率大約只有 3%，但考量到每位使用者只留下一部電影供測試，其實不算差。

cues.en: But this number by itself is going to be hard to interpret as good or bad until you have other recommenders to compare it against.
cues.zh: 不過，在有其他推薦系統可以比較之前，單看這個數字，很難判斷好壞。

cues.en: If we break it down by rating value, you can see that our hit rate did better at higher rating predictions, which makes sense and it's what we want to see.
cues.zh: 依評分值拆開來看，可以看到預測評分越高，命中率越好，這很合理，也是我們希望看到的。

cues.en: Cumulative hit rate with a 4.0 threshold isn't much lower than the raw hit rate, meaning that we're doing a good job of recommending items we think are good recommendations.
cues.zh: 門檻設為 4.0 的累積命中率，比原始命中率低不了多少，表示我們很能推薦自己認為好的項目。

cues.en: ARHR is 0.1.
cues.zh: ARHR 是 0.1。

cues.en: Again, it's just a number.
cues.zh: 同樣，它只是個數字。

cues.en: It takes the ranking of the hits into account, but honestly, for such a small data set, we're probably looking for more data than really exists for this number to be very meaningful.
cues.zh: 它考慮了命中的排名，但老實說，資料集這麼小，這個數字要非常有意義，可能需要比現有更多的資料。

cues.en: Again, it has no real value until we have other recommender systems to compare it against.
cues.zh: 同樣地，在有其他推薦系統可以比較之前，它沒有真正的價值。

cues.en: Finally, we look at user coverage for which we had at least one four-star rating prediction, and it's pretty high.
cues.zh: 最後，看至少有一筆四星預測的使用者覆蓋率，結果相當高。

cues.en: That's good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: But let's look at our diversity and novelty scores.
cues.zh: 但來看看多樣性與新穎性分數。

cues.en: Diversity is really high at 0.96.
cues.zh: 多樣性非常高，達到 0.96。

cues.en: And novelty seems pretty high, with an average popularity rank of 491.
cues.zh: 新穎性看來也相當高，平均熱門排名是 491。

cues.en: Remember, there are only a few thousand movies in our data set to begin with.
cues.zh: 記得，我們的資料集本來就只有幾千部電影。

cues.en: This tells us that our algorithm is going pretty deep into the long tail to get it's recommendations.
cues.zh: 這告訴我們，演算法為了推薦，深入到長尾中相當深的位置。

cues.en: That could be a problem in the real world.
cues.zh: 在真實世界，這可能是問題。

cues.en: So even though our accuracy metrics look okay here, diversity and novelty is telling us that we're recommending a lot of really obscure stuff.
cues.zh: 因此，雖然這裡的準確程度指標看起來還可以，多樣性與新穎性卻告訴我們，推薦了很多非常冷門的東西。

cues.en: And that could be an issue when trying to establish user trust in the system.
cues.zh: 在試圖建立使用者對系統的信任時，這可能是問題。

cues.en: People will generally want to see a few things that at least look familiar.
cues.zh: 人們通常至少想看到幾個看起來熟悉的項目。

cues.en: So I would expect that this particular algorithm wouldn't do that well in an online A/B test, but you can never really know until you actually try it.
cues.zh: 所以我預期這個演算法在線上 A/B 測試可能不會太好，但除非實際試過，永遠無法確定。

cues.en: Anyhow, we now have working code now for evaluating real recommender systems.
cues.zh: 總之，現在已有可以運作的程式碼，能評估真正的推薦系統。

cues.en: And we've seen how to use it.
cues.zh: 也看過如何使用它。

cues.en: So this will be an important foundation that we build the rest of the course on top of.
cues.zh: 這將成為其餘課程的重要基礎。

cues.en: We're just getting started, guys, so keep going.
cues.zh: 各位，我們才剛開始，繼續吧。
